properties.description:
Expose public component properties through the regular Node editor and component composition through the Repositories bush. Contributors own source interpretation, schemas, relations and mutations; the editor must not depend on individual component implementations.

Implemented: UI components are exposed as node types to the relational engine. The shared Node editor renders Fields and Additional relations, including Instance of navigation; properties update preview state, support multiline Markdown, and preserve incomplete/normalized values. Code editing rejects stale writes. Preview property edits configure the current preview and do not imply saved source changes. Repository selections also have a regular Node editor in workspace and Review.

Remaining: verify and complete contributor-owned component-composition relationships and navigation for the selected component. Repository folder/file containment is a separate relation and does not establish that this requirement is complete. Demonstrate component/source selection and preview continuity across the bush, Node editor and Review revision scope. Verify source mutation and persistence only for supported operations; unsupported cases must remain explicit.

Evidence for implemented properties and shared editors: .harness/outside-ui-verified.log (12 passing browser scenarios with inspected screenshots). Complete the remaining integration after the preceding visual review; the user's acceptance remains with the following integration review.
properties.title: Expose component properties and composition in the UI editor
